name: chevron-up
description: A balanced upward chevron with straight arms and a rounded vertex.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: This is the exact vertical reflection of Chevron Down about y=12. Mirrored 45-degree arms meet at 12,8.75, with endpoints at 5.5,15.25 and 18.5,15.25. Native bounds are centered at 12,12. Regular visible margins are 4.65 horizontally and 7.9 vertically. One continuous centerline avoids doubled joins. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
